name: Winter Soldier
notes: Plan: suit him up and swing alone. Each Equipment is +2/+0 on top of its own bonus, so cheap Equipment matter most. Menace + vigilance means he attacks and still blocks.

Double strike and protection when he attacks alone: Squall (double strike), Peggy Carter (indestructible), plus Genji Glove. With 3 Equipment and double strike he swings for 16+, lethal commander damage.

Free/cheap equipping: Puresteel Paladin (equip 0 with metalcraft), Brass Squire (tap to attach anything, incl. Colossus Hammer and Kaldra), Super-Soldier Serum, Danitha (equip 1 less), Ronin (equipment mana), Cid (Equipment spells 1 less, so Colossus Hammer is free to cast). Finders: Steelshaper's Gift, Armored Skyhunter, Adaptive Omnitool; draw from Sram, Mask, Swordsman's Steel, Swordsman.

Bracket 2: zero Game Changers (checked Nov 24 against the card data). No infinite combos, extra turns or land destruction. Game Changer swaps live in the B3 version; the buy-everything list is the Ideal B3 version.
Recursion: let him go to the graveyard and use {3}{W}{B}; he comes back with a finality counter and grabs an Equipment. Sai of the Shinobi and Super-Soldier Serum re-attach gear too.

Protection: General's Enforcer (he's legendary, so indestructible), Champion's Helm (hexproof, he's legendary), My Precious, Swiftfoot Boots, Bastion Protector, Peggy, Stolen Stark Tech, Take Up the Shield, Captain America's Shield.
Wipes: Austere Command (choose creatures + something that spares your artifacts) and Damn (spot removal early, wipe when behind).
Count (Nov 24): 35 lands (21 basics: 9 Plains, 12 Swamps), 29 Equipment, 3 Auras, 15 creatures, 5 rocks (plus Sword of the Animist), 7 removal, 3 draw spells, 1 tutor, 1 protection spell.
Oct 13: Rebuilt from the sleeved list + Oct 13 alternatives. Sleeved list was 102 cards (23 basics); trimmed to 17 basics.

Bench (considered, not in list): Thriving Heath, Thriving Moor (cut Oct 14 for Nesting Grounds, Villainous Hideout), Vibranium Energy Daggers (cut Oct 14 for Vorpal Sword), Short Sword, Well-Worn Spatula, Fireshrieker (cut Oct 13 for Bloodforged Battle-Axe, Conqueror's Flail, Nightmare Lash), Darksteel Axe (cut Oct 13 for O-Naginata), Voltaic Whip (cut Oct 13 to keep Captain America's Shield), Rogue's Gloves (cut Oct 13 for Plate Armor), Desolate Mire, Temple of Silence (cut Oct 13 land audit), Liquimetal Torque (cut for Lashwrithe), Elektra (cut Oct 13 for Cloak and Dagger), Brawler's Plate (cut Oct 13 for Lightning Greaves), Black Widow, Viper, Spider-Man Noir, Bucky Barnes, Fisk Tower (all cut Oct 13 for competitiveness), Argentum Armor, Cathar's Shield, Continue?, Costume Closet, Dancing Sword, Dark Ritual, Diabolic Tutor, Duress, Exotic Orchard, Final Act, Hidden Blade, Infinity Formula, Jhoira's Familiar, Key to the City, Power Conduit, Red Guardian, Super-Soldier, Render Speechless, S.H.I.E.L.D. Spy Kit, Slagwurm Armor, Steel Seraph, Sting, the Glinting Dagger, U.S.Agent, John Walker, Whiplash, Vengeful Engineer, Whispersilk Cloak, White Widow, Free Agent.

Bench (Oct 12 theorycraft builds, not in your pool): Akroma's Will, Anguished Unmaking, Armory Automaton, Batterskull, Benevolent Bodyguard, Bitter Triumph, Black Market Connections, Bonesplitter, Brass Squire, Brightclimb Pathway, Castle Ardenvale, Castle Locthwain, Colossus Hammer, Commander's Plate, Concealed Courtyard, Deadly Rollick, Feed the Swarm, Fighter Class, Flawless Maneuver, Generous Gift, Giver of Runes, Godless Shrine, Hammer of Nazahn, Infernal Grasp, Inventors' Fair, Land Tax, Lightning Greaves, Mithril Coat, Mother of Runes, Open the Armory, Orzhov Basilica, Phyrexian Arena, Restless Fortress, Scoured Barrens, Shadowspear, Shattered Sanctum, Sigarda's Aid, Silent Clearing, Skullclamp, Stoneforge Mystic, Stonehewer Giant, Sword of Body and Mind, Sword of Feast and Famine, Sword of Hearth and Home, Sword of Light and Shadow, Thought Vessel, Unbreakable Formation, Urza's Saga, Vault of the Archangel, Vindicate, Wayfarer's Bauble, Whispersilk Cloak.

Oct 13: Colossus Hammer in (over Lashwrithe). Free equips: Puresteel Paladin (metalcraft is easy here), Super-Soldier Serum (attaches any Equipment when he attacks), and his own graveyard recursion (attach an Equipment on return); Danitha makes it cheaper. +10/+10 plus his +2 makes him a 14/12 on its own.

Oct 13: Dropped the Marvel sub-theme for raw power. Out: Black Widow, Viper, Spider-Man Noir, Bucky Barnes, Fisk Tower. In: Brass Squire, Genji Glove, General's Enforcer, Liquimetal Torque, Swamp. Planned adds are staples not in your pool.

Oct 13: Lightning Greaves in over Brawler's Plate. Equip it LAST: suit him up first, then Greaves for 0. To add gear later, move Greaves to another creature for 0, equip, then move it back. His graveyard return attaches without targeting, so shroud doesn't stop it. Haste matters most when recasting from the command zone; returning him from the graveyard at the end of an opponent's turn lets him attack anyway.
Oct 13: Elektra out, Cloak and Dagger in. Cheaper (3 vs 4), exiles a creature OR their best card in hand, and deathtouch + lifelink makes it a real blocker.

Oct 13 land audit: out Villainous Hideout (only Winter Soldier and Swordsman are Villains now), Desolate Mire (needs {1} to tap, so it can't make mana alone), Temple of Silence (tapped). In: 3 Swamps, for 12 total. Lashwrithe back in for Liquimetal Torque. Tainted Field likes the extra Swamps (needs one to make colored mana). Sources: ~19 white, ~22 black.
Oct 13: Plate Armor in over Rogue's Gloves. +3/+3 and ward {1} (+5/+3 on him), and equip gets {1} cheaper per other Equipment, so it's usually free once he has 3 pieces. Gloves only drew a card.

Oct 13: Nettlecyst in over Voltaic Whip (Captain America's Shield stays: defense matters for a 2-toughness commander). +1/+1 per artifact AND enchantment (counts Auras, rocks, artifact lands), usually +8/+8 or more midgame; the Germ body helps Puresteel's metalcraft and gives Brass Squire/Sai a target.

Oct 13: O-Naginata in over Darksteel Axe. 1 mana, +3/+0 and trample (+5/+0 on him), the deck's second trample source with Loxodon Warhammer, so menace double-blocks and chumps don't stop damage. Needs 3+ power to attach: equip it after any other piece (he's 4/2 with one). If his power drops below 3 it falls off.

Oct 13: In: Bloodforged Battle-Axe (1 mana, +4/+0 on him, copies itself on hit), Conqueror's Flail (+2/+2; opponents can't cast spells during your turn, so no instant-speed removal while he attacks), Nightmare Lash (+1/+1 per Swamp, ~+12 with 12 Swamps; equip by paying 3 life). Out: Short Sword, Well-Worn Spatula, Fireshrieker.

Oct 14: Vorpal Sword in over Vibranium Energy Daggers. Same 1-mana cost, +4/+0 and deathtouch on him; deathtouch + menace kills both blockers, and with trample (O-Naginata, Loxodon Warhammer) he assigns just 1 to each blocker. {5}{B}: a player he hits loses the game. Equip {B}{B}{B} is easy with ~22 black sources, or free via Puresteel/Brass Squire/Serum. Daggers only added toughness, already covered by Enforcer, Shield and Plate Armor.

Oct 14: Nesting Grounds and Villainous Hideout in over Thriving Heath and Thriving Moor (your swap). Nesting Grounds can move his finality counter off him at sorcery speed, so he can die and come back again. Cost: two fewer dual sources, so watch for color-screw.

Oct 30: Shredder, Shadow Master in over Bone Saw. Second threat and clock: each unblocked swing makes every opponent lose half their life (copies attack each other opponent), so two connects put the table at ~10 and a suited-up Bucky finishes with plain combat damage, no 21 commander damage needed. Sequencing: Shredder swings alone early while Bucky suits up (attacking together turns off attack-alone payoffs like Squall and Peggy); once totals are low, swing with both. Trample gear (O-Naginata, Loxodon Warhammer) on him beats chump blocks. Other versions unchanged.
Nov 24: Metalwork Colossus pending add dropped. Shredder now fills the backup-threat job it was meant to cover; Colossus stays a spare.

Nov 24: Shredder, Shadow Master (second copy arrived) in over Fellwar Stone (your pick). Stolen Stark Tech and Danitha, Sword of Hope stay. Hammer of Nazahn goes to the oldest's Cloud deck instead, so Sai of the Shinobi stays here. Ramp is now Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Mind Stone, Orzhov Signet, Talisman of Hierarchy plus Sword of the Animist; fine for a 2-mana commander. Shredder + Squall: Shredder attacking alone gets double strike, so each opponent he connects with loses half their life twice (about 3/4 of it). Genji Glove on Shredder gives a second combat for more halvings.

Nov 24: Cut from 5 versions to 3: Today (main list, all owned, sleeved tonight), B3 (owned Game Changer swap) and Ideal B3 (buy everything). Retired B2+ sim, B3+ sim and B4 sim; backup in mtg-data decks/_retired/winter-soldier-5-versions-2026-11-24.json.

variants.name: Winter Soldier (B3)
notes: Game Changers (3), all owned: Demonic Tutor and The One Ring (both currently sleeved in Tom's Bombs) and Orcish Bowmasters (sleeved in Doom's Big Wheels). Moving them is a per-game-night swap until you own second copies.

Out: Sign in Blood, Night's Whisper, Read the Bones (The One Ring and Demonic Tutor replace the draw), 1 Swamp for Godless Shrine (unused by any other deck; it's a Swamp, so Nightmare Lash doesn't lose anything).

The One Ring: cast it the turn before you go all-in, so the protection turn covers the opponents' answers; then it draws every turn. Bowmasters: flash, pings Mother of Runes-type blockers and punishes wheel/draw tables.
If you own Smothering Tithe or Teferi's Protection, they beat Bowmasters in this deck; Bowmasters is in because it's confirmed owned.

variants.name: Winter Soldier (Ideal B3)
notes: Buys (20 cards, ~$345; ~$287 if you move your Demonic Tutor over from Tom's Bombs): see the deck's planned adds. Godless Shrine is owned. Hammer of Nazahn is a second copy (yours went to Cloud).

Built from the Oct 16 overnight sim's B3+ picks (kills by turn 12 in 81.6% vs 61.5% for the old B3): Stoneforge, Stonehewer, Sigarda's Aid, Commander's Plate, Shadowspear, Swords of Feast and Famine / Light and Shadow, Mother of Runes, Flawless Maneuver. Added Giver of Runes, Akroma's Will, Urza's Saga, Bitter Triumph, Vindicate, untapped duals. Plus Hammer of Nazahn.

Game Changers: Demonic Tutor, Necropotence, Teferi's Protection. The sim liked Mox Diamond over Teferi's, but it's ~$1,100 on the Reserved List, which is a lot of money for a card that makes you discard a land.

Cuts: the cheap draw spells (Necro replaces them), Take Up the Shield, Stolen Stark Tech, Sai of the Shinobi (Hammer does Sai's job better) and Peggy (Mother, Giver, Flawless, Akroma's Will, Teferi's cover protection better), Ronin, Cid, Swordsman, Lashwrithe, With Great Power, Wrecking Ball Arm, Mask of Memory, Sword of the Animist, Cloak and Dagger and Fracture (Bitter Triumph and Vindicate are cheaper/wider), Tainted Field, Goldmire Bridge, Vibrant Cityscape, 1 Swamp.
Shredder stays: with Squall he's a second win con that doesn't need 21 commander damage.
